title: Existence of the normalized coherent finite reduction system
statement: Let $T$ be any scheme and $\ell$ prime. There exists a System S of [def-pur-finite-reduction-system] such that S.CoherentAt(r,m,n,K) holds for all natural numbers $r\ge m\ge n$ and every etale $A_r$-derived object $K$. This asserts just the universal scalar-extension functors, their canonical comparison and associator normalizations, and their coherence, without any constructibility or Tor-amplitude conclusion.

proof.text: A candidate counit that computes on a common flat resolution is universal: its map to a given universal pair is invertible on resolutions, hence everywhere by naturality and essential surjectivity of Q. Apply this criterion to composites. [lem-pur-finite-reduction-flat-extension] and exact site comparison preserve flat resolutions, so the criterion gives both normalized associators and the normalized coefficient comparison.
